title: Multi-Mechanism FSM

hints.title: Structure: two independent switch statements
hints.content: Write one switch on `liftState` and a separate switch on `clawState`. They run one after the other in the same block of code, but each handles its own mechanism independently.

hints.title: Both mechanisms respond to the same button
hints.content: Both the lift IDLE case and the claw CLOSED case check `gamepad1.a`. When it is pressed, the lift transitions to RAISING and the claw transitions to OPEN -- both in the same iteration.

hints.title: Why repeat the switch statements?
hints.content: The first time through, both switches detect `gamepad1.a` and transition states. But the motor is still at 0.0 and the servo at 0.0 because they only set those values in the old state. The second pass enters the new states (RAISING, OPEN) and applies the correct power and position.

hints.title: Full solution walkthrough
hints.content: Write all four switch statements: lift switch (IDLE: power 0.0 + check a, RAISING: power 1.0), claw switch (CLOSED: position 0.0 + check a, OPEN: position 1.0), then repeat both. First pass transitions states; second pass applies the new state actions.
